defects.quote: jq '.jobs[] | select(.isListed) | {id, title, url:.jobUrl, loc:(.location // ""), posted:.publishedAt, remote:.isRemote}'

Likely low-probability given Greenhouse's schema, but the inconsistency in defensive coding across the three near-identical jq filters is a reviewer nit.
